title: The continuum limit of three-dimensional SU(2) lattice Yang–Mills theory on a torus III: Regional renormalization and large-field control
summary: We consider the Wilson lattice gauge measure for $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ on a periodic three-dimensional torus of fixed size, with bare coupling $g^2=g_3^2a$ proportional to the lattice spacing $a$, as dictated by the superrenormalizability of three-dimensional Yang–Mills theory. Observables are Wilson loops of the lattice configuration evolved by the Wilson flow, the lattice gradient flow of the Wilson action, at positive flow time.
